identity.title: [v0.92.1][GCP-D1] Deploy the bounded private foundation and prove non-GPU workload disposal

values.summary: Initialize #731, confirm dependency and GCP read-only gates, review the exact saved Terraform plan, prepare the authorization packet, then only after fresh authorization apply the bounded foundation, run and destroy one private e2-micro workload, prove zero residue, record evidence, obtain exact-head review, and publish.

steps.action: Bootstrap typed local state and review the issue-local design packet before execution binding.
Verify #490, GCP-B1, #492, and #493 dependency/provenance gates and inspect infra/gcp/platform without mutation.
Run read-only GCP preflight for project, region, APIs, quota, IAM, billing, remote state, and impersonation readiness without exposing secrets.
Generate and validate a saved Terraform plan for exactly the accepted foundation denominator and produce the fresh mutation authorization packet.
After explicit authorization only, apply the bounded foundation and retain live redacted readback proof.

After explicit authorization only, create exactly one labelled e2-micro private VM, prove RUNNING without external IP and one readiness observation, then destroy it and its boot disk within the authorization window.
Run independent zero-residue readback for the exact run labels and foundation drift/readback or rollback proof.
Record SOR/SRP truth, obtain exact-head independent review, publish, watch required CI, and stop before merge unless separately authorized.

invariants: No live GCP mutation happens before fresh explicit operator authorization.
The saved plan and live resources never exceed the exact denominator.
The disposable VM has no external IP, no GPU, no additional disk, no LB, no DNS, and no production traffic.
All workload resources are labelled with issue=493, ttl=disposable, csm=axioma, env=dev, unique run ID, and absolute cleanup deadline.
Rollback/destroy is unconditional by exact run ID and verified by independent absence readback.
Credentials and sensitive account material never enter tracked artifacts.
Root main remains inspection-only; implementation happens in the bound FastWork worktree.
risks: GCP APIs, quota, IAM, billing, or remote state may fail read-only preflight.
The reviewed Terraform plan may drift from the #493 denominator or include unexpected resources.
Operator authorization may expire before apply/run completes.
Disposable workload cleanup could leave labelled residue requiring immediate rollback/readback.
Terraform or GCP CLI output could expose sensitive identifiers if not redacted.
stop_conditions: Fresh mutation authorization is missing, expired, incomplete, or does not name the exact required fields.
Read-only preflight fails for required APIs, quota, IAM, billing, remote state, or impersonation readiness.
Saved plan includes unexpected replacement, public IP/route, public ingress, broad IAM, or any extra resource.
Cost estimate exceeds USD 1 proof-run cap or USD 5 foundation steady-state 30-day cap.
Any command would require printing or retaining credentials/secrets.
A disposable workload cannot be guaranteed to destroy within the authorization window.
Post-destroy readback finds any disposable workload residue.
